notes: Output-token cap: every condition runs with AGENTIGRID_MAX_TOKENS=16000 (spec-level env), which the manifest records as spec_env. An output cut off at the cap is journaled as kind 'truncated' and reported as discarded_truncated. It is not counted as a validator rejection (H3), because no proposal reached the validator.

Of-record matrix for the RAG paper (plan of 2026-09-26). Condition ids match the paper: C0, C1, C2a/b (C2c is offline-only). Graph RAG (formerly C3) is out of scope for this paper (planned follow-up).

C2b (reranker) is implemented (needs sentence-transformers; model BAAI/bge-reranker-base or AGENTIGRID_RERANKER_MODEL). Its thresholds must be fixed from labeled pairs (rag/tools/relevance_labels.py fit) and added to the C2b env as AGENTIGRID_CRAG_TAU_LOWER / _UPPER before the of-record run; until then C2b uses the cosine defaults 0.30/0.50 on reranker scores (pilot only).

C2c (Platt-calibrated reranker) is evaluated OFFLINE only (Amir, 2026-09-28): AUC and ECE of calibrated probabilities on held-out labels (rag/tools/relevance_labels.py fit). No C2c agent runs: calibration is monotone, so with thresholds fitted by the same rule C2c would make exactly C2b's grading decisions and its runs would duplicate C2b's.

case39 carries the load-maximization goal only. No contingency file ships with ExaGO for case39, and the cost-headroom pre-check (2026-09-28) found no saving reachable within the cost goal's constraints: all 10 units are online with Pmin 0 and near-zero fixed cost, so the optimal OPF baseline cannot be improved by unit commitment (0.0% over 9 changes). A cost goal there would measure nothing.

Pre-check 2026-09-26 (after patch 0010; before it, AgentiGrid-rewritten ACTIVSg cases lost genfuel and SCOPFLOW failed): on ACTIVSg200 with the shipped contingency file, SCOPFLOW is feasible wherever OPFLOW is (both through x1.6, both fail from x1.7), and the security premium is 0 through x1.3, 0.15% at x1.4, 0.34% at x1.5, 0.64% at x1.6. A 'find the N-1-secure dispatch' goal is attained by the baseline SCOPFLOW solve at every load, so it is replaced by n1cost10 on a frozen x1.5 variant.

Localized goals run on PFLOW because OPFLOW enforces line ratings and the voltage band as hard constraints. PFLOW keeps every set-point from the file, so with plain load scaling the slack unit (bus 189, Pmin 170.75, Pmax 569.15 MW) absorbs the whole change; that is physical only between about x0.86 and x1.12 on ACTIVSg200. Outside that range the variant must be written with --agc (change shared among online non-slack units in proportion to Pmax; wind curtailable, not raisable).

voltage: light-load overvoltage with the ANSI C84.1 Range A band (0.95-1.05 pu) written into the case; x0.9 keeps the slack inside its limits (~237 MW), PFLOW shows 6 voltage violations and OPFLOW is feasible with the band (cost 26554.63). relieve: forced outage of branch 134-133 at x1.6 with AGC redispatch (PFLOW: 2 overloads, max 111.6%; OPFLOW with the outage feasible, cost 42495.7). Scans at x1.0-x1.5 (agc): no single non-islanding outage overloads a line except 134-133 at x1.5 (max 102.2%); x1.6 also 113-112 (103.2%). The goal text says the out-of-service branch stays out, and the case-level guard branch_stays_out enforces it.

Frozen variants live in rag/tools/specs/cases/ (data/ is git-ignored); written by precheck_cases.py --write-stressed with the fixed MATPOWER writer. The x1.5 SCOPFLOW variant is plain-scaled: OPFLOW/SCOPFLOW re-dispatch, so file set-points are only the initial point. N-1 uses the ExaGO-shipped contingency file with all contingencies (AgentiGrid passes -scopflow_Nc -1); keep exago.mpi_np = 1 (mpi_np > 1 selects EMPAR, which the evaluator rejects).

Goal attainment: cost10 by target_pct; n1cost10 by n1_secure (feasible SCOPFLOW solve with -ctgcfile, -scopflow_Nc -1 and a coupled solver) AND target_pct on the same entry; relieve/voltage by no_violations; loadmax has no attainment predicate. Cost targets are guarded: a reduction does not count when total load is below baseline (0.1% tolerance) or a set_cost_coeffs command is in effect; cost_improvement_pct obeys the same guard and cost_guard_rejections counts rejected entries. A cell whose baseline already attains its goal (baseline_attained=1) measures nothing and must be fixed before analysis.

Cost goals state the guard in the goal text (same wording in every condition), so a guard rejection is an instruction violation and is reported per condition (cost_guard_rejections). Primary metric for cost goals: guarded cost_improvement_pct (continuous; robust to a floor effect if few runs reach 10%); goal_attained at the 10% target is secondary.

Intent guards (H3): every goal except loadmax declares deterministic goal-constraint checks, stated in its goal text identically in every condition: cost goals load_preserved + no_cost_edits; relieve load_preserved + no_rating_edits + branch_stays_out [134, 133, 0] (case-level); voltage load_preserved + vband_not_widened [0.95, 1.05]. A solve violating one never counts; per run the evaluator reports intent_violation_rate (over executed proposals) and validator_rejection_rate (LLM iterations rejected by the parser/validator, from journal discarded_actions and skipped_commands).

Planned second corpus (Amir, 2026-09-28): a documentation-augmented corpus = core corpus + the other team's documentation snapshot, as the realistic 'degraded / noisy corpus' of H1 and the harder setting for H4. It gets its own corpus dir (rag/corpus_docs, frozen with corpus_guard.py) and store (ingest --store rag/store_docs); its conditions (e.g. C1-docs, C2a-docs, C2b-docs) set "corpus": "rag/corpus_docs" and env AGENTIGRID_RAG_STORE=rag/store_docs. Not added until the snapshot is seen: licence, format, size, freeze date.

Relaxed operating limits are not cost savings (Amir, 2026-09-28): widening the voltage band or raising line ratings externalizes risk (equipment stress, voltage security) instead of lowering operating cost. Cost goals therefore also carry no_rating_edits and vband_not_widened 'case' (the runner resolves it to the case file's own band). A soft-constraint (penalty) or cost-vs-voltage-deviation Pareto formulation that prices this trade-off is future work, not part of this study.

Cost-goal headroom (precheck_cases.py --cost-headroom, 2026-09-28): ACTIVSg200 x1.0 OPFLOW base 27,557.57, greedy unit-commitment changes reach 40.3% (15 changes) -- the 10% target is reachable, mainly by decommitting units whose fixed cost OPF pays even at Pmin; ACTIVSg200 x1.5 OPFLOW stand-in 17.2% (13 changes); SCOPFLOW confirmation for n1cost10 pending.
Run from the agentigrid project root with the venv active and OLLAMA_HOST set.

goals.text: Reduce total generation cost by 10% while serving the same load (reducing or shedding load does not count), without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings
Find the maximum uniform load scaling factor before the system becomes infeasible

Reduce the total generation cost of the N-1-secure dispatch (secure against all contingencies) by 10% while serving the same load (reducing or shedding load does not count), without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings
Relieve all overloaded transmission lines while keeping bus voltages within their limits, without shedding load, changing line ratings, or returning the out-of-service branch to service
Eliminate all bus voltage violations while keeping line loadings within their ratings, without shedding load or changing the bus voltage limits
